description: Phase 2 retrieval-eval extension: 10 additional corpus documents (5 experiments, 3 failures, 2 findings) + 6 research-intent queries with graded relevance judgments and must-recall failure cases. Same schema as eval_fixture.json (version pinned to 0.1.0 so runner.py loads it unchanged); doc/query IDs carry a p2 infix so the Phase 2 seeder (seed_phase2.py) can merge both fixtures without collisions. Covers intermediate-horizon momentum, short-leg borrow costs, monthly-factor attribution joins, DSL-blended ML composites, multi-view Black-Litterman, and PIT/restatement discipline for fundamentals.

documents.title: Factor tearsheet: mom_63d intermediate momentum, monthly
documents.text: Single-factor evaluation of the intermediate mom_63d signal at a 63-day horizon: IC mean 0.027, ICIR 0.58, t-stat 2.01, hit rate 0.55. Quintile long-short backtest earns Sharpe 0.55 with 3.1x turnover and 92% rebalance coverage. Bridges the gap between short-horizon mom_21d and the 126-day baseline on the IC decay curve.

documents.title: Reversal backtest with explicit borrow costs on the short leg
documents.text: spark-mcp 15.2 reversal backtest with borrow costs charged on the short leg: 150 bps annualized borrow adds 0.22 Sharpe points of drag on top of 5 bps costs plus 2 bps slippage, taking net Sharpe to 0.31 from gross 0.71. Purge 5 and embargo 10 splits with a PIT universe; OOS Sharpe 0.18. Short-leg borrow is first-order for any long-short reversal claim.

documents.title: Attribution on monthly AQR quality and betting-against-beta factors
documents.text: Factor attribution of a quality-tilted portfolio on monthly AQR QMJ and BAB factors plus the market, joined to holdings via month periods (asof) so no month-end factor rows are dropped. Quality beta 0.34 with t-stat 3.1, BAB 0.19, R-squared 0.88, insignificant alpha 0.8%. Cross-frequency joins must use month periods, never naive calendar-day equality.

documents.title: Walk-forward ridge blend with a DSL-defined value feature
documents.text: Walk-forward ML composite at a 63-day horizon: ridge regression fit only on data strictly before each monthly rebalance blends mom_126d with a DSL-defined value feature (price over trailing 1-year moving average minus one) using 504 training dates. Latest coefficients load 0.55 on momentum and 0.31 on value with 90% coverage. Point-in-time with no look-ahead; DSL features compose with built-in signals.

documents.title: Black-Litterman tilt with two opposing sector views

params.views: AAPL outperforms the basket; XOM underperforms the basket

documents.text: Black-Litterman optimization from an equal-cap prior with two views: AAPL outperforms the basket while XOM underperforms. Tilts AAPL up 3.2 percentage points and XOM down 2.6 points with stable weights elsewhere (max 14%). Multiple views compose cleanly when each view portfolio is specified outright; views default to historical means when unspecified.

documents.title: Restated fundamentals overstate value IC twofold
documents.text: Failed experiment: a value factor built on latest restated fundamentals showed IC 0.041, but rebuilding on point-in-time vintage fundamentals cut IC to 0.018 — restatement bias overstated the signal more than twofold. Lesson: fundamentals must be vintage-stamped (dataset_version with vintage_at); any factor using as-reported-latest accounting data inherits look-ahead bias.

documents.title: Omitted borrow costs flip a long-short reversal claim negative
documents.text: Failed experiment: a long-short reversal backtest claimed Sharpe 0.52 with only 5 bps costs and 2 bps slippage, but charging realistic short-leg borrow flipped net Sharpe to -0.05 (borrow drag 0.57 Sharpe points at 16.2x turnover). Lesson: long-short backtests must charge borrow explicitly via the costs model; gross-of-borrow Sharpe is not evidence.

documents.title: Twelve-month momentum hypothesis fails in the post-2022 regime
documents.text: Failed hypothesis: the 12-month top-50 momentum design earned Sharpe 0.64 in sample but -0.12 out of sample over 2023-2026, consistent with post-publication crowding and a regime break rather than a coding or data error. Lesson: momentum premia carry regime risk; hypotheses need validity windows (effective_from/effective_to) and OOS confirmation before promotion to validated findings.

documents.title: Short-leg borrow must be modeled explicitly in long-short evaluation
documents.text: Methodological finding: borrow costs on the short leg drag long-short Sharpe by 0.2 to 0.6 points at realistic turnover, enough to flip marginal reversal claims negative. Supported by the borrow-aware reversal backtest and the omitted-borrow failure; every long-short evaluation must report net-of-borrow metrics with the borrow assumption stated.

documents.title: Fundamentals factors require point-in-time vintages, not restated snapshots
documents.text: Data-quality finding: accounting-based factors built on restated snapshots overstate IC by about twofold versus point-in-time vintages (0.041 vs 0.018 on the value DSL signal). Supported by the restatement-bias failure; dataset versions for fundamentals must carry vintage_at and every factor run must record which vintage it consumed.
